name: Ordalie-FR-Reranking-benchmark
description: A French-language reranking dataset that provides queries paired with candidate passages/documents and relevance labels for evaluating reranking models. It measures a model's ability to reorder retrieval results to place the most relevant items highest. Typical use is to fine-tune and evaluate neural rerankers for French information retrieval scenarios.
reputation: A niche French reranking dataset from OrdalieTech with limited but growing use in francophone IR research and engineering.
